sampling.method: ffmpeg frame extraction at one-second timestamps; values transcribed from visible percentage text

visibleMotion: The luminous front tracks the displayed percentage position.
The front is irregular during travel, with changing rounded lobes and concave pinches rather than a rigid translated shape.
A broad blue haze extends behind the bright front into the filled region; no detached trailing blob is visible.
At zero the front is absent; at 100 it clips and compresses against the rounded right end.
Feature text and percentage remain crisp and stationary while the fill moves behind them.
